items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: And it paid very well for those times, and I could have a mixed band. I had Sandy Williams, Kaiser Marshall, Cecil Scott, Herb Ward, Henry Goodwin and myself.

ctx.x: I finally broke with these people in a way. They gave me a job in a place called Camp Unity, and I'm writing

about that. In Camp Unity, it was outside of New York. And it paid very well for those times, and I could have a mixed band. I had Sandy Williams, Kaiser Marshall, Cecil Scott, Herb Ward, Henry Goodwin and myself.
At that time, just for a little clarification, was it still difficult to book a mixed band in New York?
